faqIntro: Need more information? Ask when you book.
faqs: Inspection, careful disassembly, cleaning of filters, the heat exchanger and internal components, condensate drainage system cleaning, disinfection, reassembly and testing. The heat exchanger cleaner and any rinsing are selected according to the equipment and cleaner manufacturers’ instructions. The exact work depends on the model and condition.
How often should an air conditioner be cleaned?

Professional cleaning is usually scheduled once a year, before the main season of use. Year-round operation or dusty conditions may require more frequent cleaning, depending on the system’s condition. Check washable filters roughly every two weeks and clean them according to your model’s instructions.

We serve Sderot to Haifa, including Ashkelon, Ashdod, Rehovot, Rishon LeZion, Tel Aviv, Petah Tikva, Netanya and Hadera. We also cover Tel Aviv to Jerusalem, including Lod, Ramla, Modi’in and Beit Shemesh. See the service area section for the main cities.
How much does cleaning several units cost?
One wall-mounted AC costs ₪250, two cost ₪450, and three cost ₪600. Contact us for a quote for more units.
Diagnostics and servicing for central air conditioners and VRF systems are quoted separately by prior arrangement.
Clear the space beneath the AC, move fragile objects and tell us about any access difficulties beforehand.
Does a submitted request confirm a booking?
No. We will agree on the time, price and scope of work after receiving your request.
Does my AC need a refrigerant recharge every year?
No. Refrigerant circulates in a closed system and is not consumed like fuel. A low level calls for investigation and a possible leak check. We agree on a recharge after checking the system.
How much does an AC refrigerant recharge cost?

The price depends on the model, refrigerant type and quantity, and system condition. Send us the model and describe the problem. Recharging is quoted separately and is not included in cleaning prices.
